events.title: Jazz at LAMP: In Memory of Sonny Rollins
events.description: On August 29 , join Mike Murley (sax), Tom Easley (bass), Nick Halley (drums), and Richard White (guitar) for a special performance in memory of legendary saxophonist and jazz icon Sonny Rollins (1930-2026) . Through a selection of music inspired by Rollins’ extraordinary career and enduring influence, the quartet will celebrate one of the most important voices in jazz history with their artistry and improvisation.

events.title: Chris Garneau
events.description: Chris first emerged from the New York music scene with Music for Tourists, gaining international attention. Since then, he’s toured across North America, Europe, Asia, and Brazil, sharing stages with Xiu Xiu, José González, and Charlotte Gainsbourg.

events.title: Jack Pine; Tea & Scones Concert
events.description: When Jack takes the stage, you can't help but howl and sing along to his wry folk wisdom - at once biting and inspiring - as his mandolin plays furiously then softly. This is alt-folk singer-songery for those who'd rather dance to mandolin rhythms than drum machine beats ...or just sit and dig on some real good tunes for real dark times.
events.price: $30 for ground floor seating & scones; $15 for balcony seating (no scones)
